newsitem.title: USA: Hertz fires back at WSJ with full-page ad.
newsitem.headline: Hertz fires back at WSJ with full-page ad.

text.p: Herz Corp took out a full page advertisement in the front section of Thursday's Wall Street Journal criticizing a July 17 article in the paper that depicted car rental companies as unconcerned with customer service.
"As we advised your reporter, the delays and long lines at the counter she reports don't apply to Hertz," the advertisement says.
The July 17 article said, "Throughout the rental process, many customers feel neglected."
Hertz, in its advertisement, said the article "omits many important points that put the industry's customer service performance - and Hertz's industry leadership - in far sharper focus."
Hertz said its market dominance stems directly from its reputation for superior customer service.
The advertisement goes on to descibe the company's programs and operations that enhance service.
